paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of articles across political leanings of the outlets
model_annotation: The pie chart, titled "Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse," illustrates the distribution of articles across different political leanings of media outlets, with the data presented as percentages and corresponding raw counts in parentheses. The chart is divided into four colored segments: a blue segment labeled "Right bias" representing 30.0% (30 articles), an orange segment labeled "Left bias" at 28.0% (28 articles), a green segment labeled "Questionable source" accounting for 22.0% (22 articles), and a red segment labeled "Left center bias" making up 20.0% (20 articles). Each slice is clearly labeled with its category name and percentage value, and the percentages sum to 100.0%. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right, with the largest slice being "Right bias" and the smallest being "Left center bias."
